How to Play Slippity Slide{KP}"It's a game where you race up the Ice Tower to the top floor!"{KP}"You compete for the best time to the top floor!"{KP}"Along the way, there are floors that reverse your controls..."{KP}"Slippery floors! 氷の床！

jp:
でこぼこ氷の床！

en: Bumpy ice floor! Look carefully at the directional buttons around you!

jp:
のぼり　かいだん！

jp:

ではいりのはしらを　そうさ　します！

jp:
ではいりのはしら！

en: In-and-out pillars! The pillars pop out and sink back in!

jp:
ワープの床！
他の　ワープの床へ　移動します！
en: Warp floor! It sends you to another warp floor!
